purpose: Reusable MTP acceptance/effective-speed benchmark. Tier A (coding agent + translation) decides adoption; Tier B (creative) is measured but never gates.

M1.name: expected_pq_acceptance
M1.definition: per proposal row sum_t min(p'(t), q'(t)); p' and q' are target and draft distributions after the engine support transform; averaged per prompt
M1.support_transform: reference token selector top_k/top_p branch: logit desc with lower id on ties, top_k 20, softmax, smallest prefix reaching top_p*sum (>=1), renormalise; temperature 1.0
M1.conditioning: production-faithful forced mode P (Phase86): width-2 chain with draft hidden at step 2 and production keep/rewind
M1.requires: forced report storing both draft and target logits (draft_logit_rows / target_logit_rows)
M1.pairing: draft and target rows paired by (sequence_index, block_row) within one run
M1.inference: prompt cluster; bootstrap and two-sided sign-flip over prompts, never positions
M1.revised: 2026-09-17; before this date M1 values were top-1 agreement and are now M1_top1

M1_top1.name: top1_agreement
M1_top1.use: flip and margin analysis only; never an adoption input
M1_top1.note: discretises near-tie positions; about 3x wider prompt-cluster intervals than M1 in Phase86

M4.name: derived_decode_tokens_per_second
M4.tokens_per_block_model: 1 + a1 + a1*a2 for width 2, a_k = M1 of proposal step k (independence approximation)
M4.validated_against: V620 BF16 53 blocks, 74 accepted, 12.847+82.808 ms -> 25.05 vs measured 25.049
M4.note: when a candidate changes only the draft path, hold non_draft_ms_per_block at the control value

M5.name: free_running_end_to_end
M5.note: Never overrides M4; record divergence instead.

require_all: Tier A M4 (from M1 expected acceptance and M3) exceeds BF16 with prompt-cluster CI excluding zero on BOTH exact targets
Tier A M1 expected acceptance not lower than BF16 by more than 1.0 point
prefill and M>1 paths including WMMA selection do not regress
adoption_rule.single_gpu_result: keep BF16 default; retain as selectable path and record scope

quick.note: development regression only; never decides adoption

sampling.note: the Qwen3.8 NVFP4 CLI fixes temperature=1.0 and forbids greedy

reference_sequence_provenance.derivation: tokenize(output_text); the sequence is a forced input, not a reproduction target
reference_sequence_provenance.input_mode: chat template single user turn (--message user:...)

revisions.change: M1 switched from top-1 agreement to expected p/q acceptance under production-faithful conditioning; top-1 kept as M1_top1 auxiliary. Fixture identity (prompts, sequences, output length, width, KV) unchanged, so schema_version stays mtp-bench-v1; M1 values before and after this date are not comparable.
revisions.also: replaced stale condition ids in M3, M5 and profiles.quick with ids that exist in this manifest
